source.note: PAIRWISE witness of the copy -> cast-DRIVER edge (CR 707.10): a stack spell-copy re-fires the copied spell's OWN effects (the copy is NOT cast) into a type-compatible spell's cast:spell:self driver. bench 147-1987 (Ghostly Flicker + Dualcaster Mage) is the combo this edge belongs to; this gold witnesses only the ONE edge (pairwise, no loop_tier claimed here) -- the FULL 2-edge loop (blink->etb THEN copy->cast) is pinned separately at SpellCopyFlowArmScopeTest.Ghostly_flicker_x_dualcaster_reconstructs_amber_the_double_identity_floor, audited 2026-07-18 (Currency-B precision-fix pass) and confirmed IRREDUCIBLY AMBER -- not a temporary gap pending a future graft: the blink->etb edge and this copy->cast edge each float on the caster's free choice of legal target (an identity the AST cannot statically prove), so no GREEN is reachable through this 2-card cycle. REAL PORTS (grounded, not a wish): Dualcaster Mage's ETB 'copy target instant or sorcery spell' (Target.Zone:Stack) projects emit:copy:spell:instant+sorcery -- CopyFamily.Recognize returns PortStructure.Of(Emit, 'copy', ('resource','spell')), Subject={instant,sorcery} (isSelf empty); see the live dualcaster-mage.json interaction snapshot. Ghostly Flicker is a Kind:spell instant with flow emits (exile+return blink), so PortGraph projects the cast:spell:self driver -- CastDriverFamily.Recognize returns PortStructure.Of(Consume, 'cast', ('role','driver')), Subject=SpellSelf {instant,sorcery} IsSelf=true (byte-identical to the live reiterate.json snapshot's cast:spell:self). The ('copy','cast') arm (PortGraphEngine.SpellCopyReFiresEffects) materializes the edge; AddRulesEdge tiers it AMBER via the IsSelf Subsumes=No floor. RESOURCE-AXIS SURFACE: the spell-copy carries a resource=spell facet (the load-bearing distinction -- only a spell-copy, never a permanent token-copy like Kiki-Jiki's bare emit:copy, re-fires a cast driver, CR 707.10) that is NOT in the closed attribute_axes set. Per the kiki-jiki-mirror-breaker precedent, resource is surfaced as a taxonomy/axis decision, NOT authored as a port attr; the copied-type {instant,sorcery} rides in the port note (no card-type axis for the copy target exists in the closed set, per the archaeomancer precedent). No CSB popularity COUNT is available in the testbed source (edhrec/price absent) -- popularity omitted (not fabricated).

Dualcaster Mage.note: the driver -- 'When this creature enters' (Trigger.Event=Enters, Filter.IsSelf=true, CardTypes=[creature]); a self-watching ETB subscription (live etb:creature:self). Already-witnessed stem, shown to ground the card-defined flow into the spell-copy emit.

THE WITNESS (emit side) -- 'copy target instant or sorcery spell' (EffectType=copy, Target.Filter.CardTypes=[instant,sorcery], Zone=Stack). A STACK spell-copy (CR 707.10): the live engine projects emit:copy:spell:instant+sorcery (CopyFamily.Recognize -> PortStructure.Of(Emit,'copy',('resource','spell')), Subject={instant,sorcery}). Authored as the bare copy stem (matching kiki-jiki's witnessed copy stem): the resource=spell facet is OFF the closed attribute_axes set, so it is surfaced as the axis question (see source.note), NOT invented as a port attr; the copied-type {instant,sorcery} rides in this note (no card-type axis for the copy target). DISTINCT from a permanent token-copy (Kiki-Jiki's bare emit:copy, no :spell) -- a spell-copy lives on the stack and has NO ETB/untap to graft as a permanent.

Ghostly Flicker.note: THE DRIVER (consume side) -- Ghostly Flicker is a Kind:spell instant whose on-cast effect (exile+return blink) fires BECAUSE the spell was cast (CR 601.2f->608). PortGraph projects cast:spell:self (CastDriverFamily.Recognize -> PortStructure.Of(Consume,'cast',('role','driver')), Subject=SpellSelf {instant,sorcery} IsSelf=true). Authored with subject=self to express the IsSelf identity (the spell driving its OWN effects) -- the same convention deadeye/archaeomancer use for a self-watching consume, and what distinguishes this DRIVER from Aang's 'whenever you cast' TRIGGER (which carries control=you/subtype, no self). The structural role=driver facet is carried here as subject=self, matching the aang cast-trigger gold which likewise carries no bare 'role' facet.

notes: 'When Dualcaster Mage enters, copy target instant or sorcery spell' -- a deterministic card-defined flow from the ETB subscription to the spell-copy emit; structural (self-certifying), no rule dependency. Mirrors the live CardDefinedEdge etb:creature:self -> emit:copy:spell:instant+sorcery in the dualcaster-mage interaction snapshot.

THE WITNESS EDGE (emit:copy:spell -> cast:spell:self). The copy of Ghostly Flicker reproduces Ghostly Flicker's OWN effects (CR 707.10 -- a copy of a spell is put on the stack and is NOT cast; it reproduces the copied spell's characteristics, modes, targets, and X), so it feeds the copied spell's cast:spell:self effect-DRIVER -- NEVER a 'whenever you cast' trigger:cast (a copy isn't cast, and the ('copy','cast') arm's Role!=trigger keying makes a cast-trigger match structurally impossible). Materialized by PortGraphEngine.SpellCopyReFiresEffects.

AMBER via the IsSelf Subsumes=No floor (guard:self-watch): G1 is a subject=self driver (the spell watching its OWN cast), and D1's copied-spell filter {instant,sorcery} only Intersects (Overlaps, NOT Subsumes) that IsSelf self-type -- the operator cannot see the object identity that the copied spell IS this very spell. Honest AMBER, never a false GREEN.
